about.description: Arcus perpetual market tracking SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSE Arca: SPY) with 24/7 exposure to the underlying S&P 500 index ETF. Total-return tracking (dividends, splits, and futures rolls passed through funding), cash-settled in USDG on the Arcus off-chain CLOB with permissioned appchain re-verification and EVM rootchain custody.
